courses.title: Advanced Algorithms & Complexity
courses.description: Rigorous study of algorithmic design paradigms including dynamic programming, greedy methods, amortized analysis, network flow, and introduction to NP-completeness and approximation algorithms.

courses.title: Distributed Systems & Cloud Architecture
courses.description: Principles of reliable distributed computing: consensus protocols (Paxos, Raft), replication models, logical clocks, Byzantine fault tolerance, and scalable cloud storage primitives.

courses.title: Signals, Systems & Digital Filtering
courses.description: Continuous and discrete-time signals, linear time-invariant systems, convolution, Fourier series and transforms, Z-transforms, sampling theorem, and digital filter synthesis in MATLAB.

courses.title: Mathematical Statistics & Inference
courses.description: Classical probability distributions, convergence in probability, maximum likelihood estimation, confidence intervals, Neyman-Pearson hypothesis testing, and Bayesian statistical paradigms.

courses.title: Computational Genomics & Sequence Analysis
courses.description: High-throughput sequencing analysis, sequence alignment algorithms (Needleman-Wunsch, Smith-Waterman, BLAST), phylogenetic trees, hidden Markov models in gene finding, and structural bioinformatics.

courses.title: Econometrics & Causal Inference
courses.description: Statistical foundation of empirical economic research: linear regression, instrumental variables, differences-in-differences, regression discontinuity, and panel data methods with Stata and R.
